caseName: United States v. Milavetz, Gallop & Milavetz, P.A.
caseNameFull: UNITED STATES v. MILAVETZ, GALLOP & MILAVETZ, P.A.

opinions.text: Motion of the parties to amend briefing schedule and expand word limits granted. Petitioners in No. 08-1119 will file an opening brief, not to exceed 20,000 words, on or before August 25, 2009. Petitioner in No. 08-1225 will file a response brief, not to exceed 20,000 words, on or before October 21, 2009. Petitioners in No. OS-1119 will file a reply brief, not to exceed 10,000 words, on or before November 20, 2009.
